companies.name: マーテン・トランスポート

relations.text: Martenのインターモーダル事業(冷凍コンテナ1,200超)を5,180万ドルで取得(2025年9月)
relations.text_en: Bought Marten's intermodal business, including 1,200+ refrigerated containers, for $51.8 million (September 2025)

source.label: Marten Transport 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The transaction was structured as an asset sale of certain Intermodal equipment, including over 1,200 refrigerated containers, and associated customer contracts to Hub Group, Inc. for $ 51.8 million in cash.

relations.text: メキシコのEASOの支配株式を取得する契約(2024年10月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to acquire a controlling interest in Mexico's EASO (October 2024)

source.label: Hub Group 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: we entered into an investment agreement with Corporación Interamericana de Logística, S.A. de C.V. and certain associated entities (commonly known as "EASO"), to acquire a controlling interest in EASO.

relations.text: Forward Airのラストマイル事業FAFMを買収(2023年12月)

source.label: Hub Group 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On December 20, 2023, we acquired 100% of the equity interests of Forward Air Final Mile ("FAFM").

companies.name: タッグ・ロジスティクス

source.label: Hub Group 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On August 22, 2022, we acquired TAGG Logistics, LLC ("TAGG").
